text_block_list.text: I'm shopping at the mall with Seiun Sky and Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Grass! I found the incense.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you. They've got quite a lot here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I wonder which one will help with insomnia…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Incense that helps you catch some Zs, huh? I don't think I'd need much help with that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Only takes me about three seconds to find my way to dreamland, whenever or wherever.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, the way you always keep your composure is commendable.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's see… They have electric burners we can test. Shall we try some out?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's start with sandalwood.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes… It has a lovely, soothing fragrance.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Zzz.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hm? Sei? Can you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa… Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Was I snoozing just now?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well, well… How interesting.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's try lavender next. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Um… Grass, wait a sec—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmm…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nya-ha-ha… Fouuund you, Grass… Now it's my turn… to hide… Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Look at that. Perhaps she's playing hide and seek in a lavender field.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now, what happens when I try lemon?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Grass… Cut it out… You can't eat… a whole lemon in one… whoa…
choice_data_list: That's quite a dream she's having.
That's quite a dream she's having.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Oh, Sei. You know I'd never do a thing like that.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Who knew incense could have this strong of an effect? ♪ It wouldn't hurt to try out a few more.
Grass Wonder continues testing one stick after another.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Curry-scented incense? What a rare find! Let's make this our last one.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmm… So we're having curry today? Smells good—huh? You're gonna feed me… with your eyes closed?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait… You have to let it cool… Ack! Hot! It's too hot!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No no no noooo!
choice_data_list: You're okay, it's just a dream.
You're okay, it's just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wha… a dream?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it appears the curry scent isn't very well-suited for sleeping. I've certainly learned a lot. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Grass… You were just using those last few ones to mess with me, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, not at all. As if I would do such a thing! I simply wanted to make an informed decision.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmph…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: She was probably messing with you.
She was making an informed decision.
She was making an informed decision.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list: She was probably messing with you.
She was making an informed decision.
She was making an informed decision.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I knew it! Grrr, I am capable of getting mad, you know!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But I've got a one-way ticket to Snoozetown with your name on it! Smell thi—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mmm… Snooze… Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Dear me…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Should we take a picture?
Watching Seiun Sky sabotage herself like that, I feel as if I've witnessed something never before seen.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Precisely. Now, since you apologized for your mistake, and to repay you for helping me…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll give you a keychain with a little bag of catnip attached. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmph…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Meow you're talking.
Grass Wonder has Seiun Sky wrapped around her finger… She's truly fearsome!
